subject: [hw] DONE V11 rev 4 (960/960; PKH is differentially covered)
body:
Rev 4, final count and one evidence correction; implementation unchanged since rev 2.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V11 PASS 960/960
    N2TEST V11 PASS 960/960

Changes since rev 3 (tests/STATUS only):
1. One more SMUSD case: Q is already 1 entering the instruction and must stay 1 (SMUSD cannot overflow, so it never sets or clears Q). This makes the resolved Q question directly testable.
2. Evidence correction: I said earlier PKH was not exercised by the differential ARM rows. It is: the ARM -O2/-O3v/armv8 objects of k_v11_pack contain two `pkhbt` instructions (verified with llvm-objdump: e6813010 pkhbt r3,r1,r0 and e6800011 pkhbt r0,r0,r1) and those rows have 0 mismatches. At -O0 clang uses and/orr, which is why my first look missed them. The unit tests still cover both PKHBT/PKHTB and every shift.
3. STATUS line-count and UNDEF-count corrections (806-line implementation; 57 must-be-UNDEF cases; 387-line v11_enc.s).

All other rev 1-3 statements stand. No V11 review findings have been posted; R1s independent spot suite still has all V11 checks passing (its 5 failures are V14/V15). Staying available.
